concepts.label: Analytics service-level configuration parameter

notable_absence.finding: None of the roughly 40 service-level and node-specific configuration parameters on this page carry an Enterprise/Community edition gate or a version-availability citation, unlike other reference modules already in the registry (compression, storage-modes) where individual settings are frequently edition- or version-gated. The entire table is presented as uniformly available, with no mention of when any parameter was introduced or whether any is edition-restricted.

cross_component_finding: Several Analytics service-level parameters (analyticsBroadcastDcpStateMutationCount, dcpBufferAckWatermark, dcpConnectionBufferSize, dcpChannelReconnectRemoteIdleSeconds, collectDcpStateFromNodesTimeout) are explicitly DCP-tuning knobs, confirming in the Analytics module's own configuration surface that protocol:dcp (already promoted as the mechanism feeding the Index, Search and Analytics services from the Data Service) is literally the ingestion path this service's own operators tune - not just an architectural claim made on other services' pages.
